title: Decanter: Shopify Store Rebuild & Ongoing Improvements
description: I rebuilt Decanter's Shopify store to make a large catalogue easier to browse and everyday updates easier for the team. The work covered 150 collection templates, 11 pages, improved search and filters, clearer product details, editable badges, store availability and cart improvements. After launch, I refined image loading, reviews and mobile layouts. The refreshed store gives shoppers clearer buying information and the merchant more control over content. I continue to support the store with fixes and improvements.

title: Scented Helsinki: Standalone Shopify Store Build & Launch
description: Scented Helsinki needed its own Shopify store after sharing a storefront with another brand. I built the standalone store, prepared and checked the product catalogue, connected its own domain and supported the launch. I also improved the display of Judge.me ratings and review counts, and added automatic preorder behaviour that returns to the normal out-of-stock state when preorder conditions no longer apply. The brand now has a live storefront of its own, with clear product information and buying options for fragrance shoppers.

title: Shopify Theme Customization & Launch (10 Days)
description: Collaborated with littlebigworld to lead the Shopify build for Gladys Books & Wine, a queer-owned Brooklyn bookstore and wine lounge. Customized the Shapes theme with full brand integration, typography, and color system. Built core pages, integrated Ingram book import, events, newsletter, and automated fulfillment. Delivered a fully branded, mobile-optimized storefront and smooth Squarespace-to-Shopify migration in just 10 days.

title: Toddies Kidswear – Shopify Store Launch
description: Built Toddies’ debut kidswear store on Shopify, recreating Equalite’s style while fitting the brand. Delivered pages and collections, bundle products, custom fonts, color swatches, multilingual setup, EU‑compliant VAT & shipping rules. Integrated Sendcloud returns, TikTok ads, Judge.me reviews, Rewind backups, and a countdown password landing page. Managed work in Trello, trained the client, and provided on‑call launch support.

title: Cosmetics Shopify Store
description: I built Elysia Cosmetics’ Shopify store, tailoring a premium theme with HTML, CSS, JS, and Liquid. Dynamic variants and metafield‑driven content keep every product detail precise and on‑brand. A video hero, refined UX, and built‑in affiliate links elevate engagement and sales. Post‑launch fixes and polish delivered a turnkey site the client enthusiastically endorses.
